title: Hiring of Vehicles for Official Purpose at Cochin Directorate during the period April 2024 to March 2025
summary: Sealed two-cover quotations from travel agencies/tour operators to supply various classes of hired vehicles with drivers, on km/hour/day basis as required, for official use by the Cochin (Kochi) Directorate from April 2024 to March 2025.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: Toyota Innova Crysta (AC) - rates up to 80 km/8 hrs, additional km, additional hours, driver allowance after 8 hrs
Mahindra Xylo / Marazzo / Maruti Suzuki Ertiga / XL6 (7 or 8 seater MUV, AC)
Maruti Suzuki Swift Dezire / Toyota Etios / Honda Amaze (5 seater sedan, AC)
Maruti Suzuki Swift / Tata Tiago / Tata Punch (5-seater hatchback, AC)

money.performance_security: Rs 10,000 (FDR or bank guarantee), valid 3 months beyond contract tenure
money.notes: EMD by DD in favour of The Director, Directorate of LH & LS, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam (NIT says DD/FDR valid three months). NSIC/MSME certificate holders may seek exemption. Rates inclusive of POL, fuel, maintenance, driver allowance; GST paid on billing; rates fixed for 12 months, no escalation. L1 on consolidated total of schedule; financial evaluation assumes 100 km / 10 hrs trip. The bank guarantee proforma mentions 10% of contract value and a footnote says 3%, inconsistent with the fixed Rs 10,000.

period.bid_validity: Rates valid for 12 months, until March 2025

eligibility: Company registration in Kerala and a local office in Kochi (proof by BSNL bill, registration certificate or Govt document; rental agreement not accepted)
At least three years of experience providing hired vehicles to Government/Semi-Govt/PSUs
At least 10 vehicles of its own (RC/ownership/lease documents)
Not blacklisted, unconditional bid and acceptance of terms (Annexure III affidavits); no near relatives affidavit
Last 3 years income tax returns and proof of financial stability
specs: Vehicles not older than five years, commercially registered, with 'ON GOVT OF INDIA DUTY' sticker
Drivers with valid licence and 5 years experience, uniform, mobile phone; Malayalam plus Hindi/English
Substitute vehicle within one hour on breakdown; 24-hour telephone facility
notes: NIQ dated 27.03.2024. Download 28.03.2024 09:00 to 08.04.2024 14:00; submission 28.03.2024 14:00 to 08.04.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 09.04.2024 16:00. No estimated cost or vehicle quantities printed (orders as per actual requirement). Schedule (Annexure II) lists only AC vehicle rates. Rest of document is standard proformas (BG, EMD, acceptance, undertaking, non-blacklist, near relatives).
